$Comment: The Second Oath: the one-time quest whose reward opens a player's second oath slot. The Mastery
Trainer offers it once a Focus is finished, all five of its steps owned, which the Requires reads as
any Honed II step owned (ziggfreedcommon:track_picks_taken over Mmo_Focus_*_Honed_II, so a Focus a
pack adds counts with no edit here).
Requires also asks for a sworn Focus (ziggfreedcommon:track_stance on the oath set Mmo_Focus, Min 1),
so it is taken with an oath standing, and for the slot key not owned yet
(ziggfreedcommon:track_pick_owned on Defense/Mmo_Focus_Slot_II, Max 0), so a player who already holds
the second slot is never offered it. Listing.ShowWhen shows it to anyone with a finished Focus and no
key, so a player with no oath sworn sees it locked, with the reason, at the trainer. Requires is asked
when the quest is taken: a quest step has no condition of its own, so once it is taken each kill
counts whether an oath is still held or not, and its words ask for no more than that.
The kill step names no target, so any creature counts. Every kill happens out in the world: nothing
in the Adventurers' Hall or the Forgotten Temple can be fought. Npc.TurnInId 'giver' adds the walk
back to the trainer one order behind it, and Flow.HideLockedSteps keeps that walk off the list until
Its reward is the slot key, collected from the trainer's quest list like every reward here, never paid
on completion: owning Mmo_Focus_Slot_II on the Defense track is what opens slot II of the oath set
(TrackStances/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus.json). The Pick reward kind in its one Rewards.Claim row teaches
it. It pays no Mastery Point.
